MTCategoryType.description: Represents the \gls{category} attribute of the MTConnect \gls{MTDataItem}.

EVENT.description: An event category is a data item representing a discrete piece of           information from the piece of equipment.

CONDITION.description: A condition category is a data item that communicates information           about the health of a piece of equipment and its ability to function.

SAMPLE.description: A sample category is the reading of the value of a continuously           variable or analog data value.
